description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling RetrieveFeatureProperties commands in a persistent actor context. It extracts feature properties from Thing objects, constructs appropriate responses, and manages entity tags for concurrency control.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class that implements a strategy to retrieve properties of a feature within a Thing, handling command application, feature extraction, response creation, and entity tag management.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Processes the RetrieveFeatureProperties command, extracts the feature, and returns the feature properties or an error result.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the feature with the specified ID from the Thing, or throws if not found.

methods.name: getFeatureProperties
methods.description: Creates a result containing the feature's properties as JSON, or an error if properties are not found.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertiesJson
methods.description: Serializes FeatureProperties to JSON, optionally selecting specific fields.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag for the previous entity state.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates an entity tag for the new entity state based on the feature's properties.
